modes.label: Assistant
modes.adminDenied: Needs the ai:admin or admin:panel permission

developer.label: Developer
developer.title: Developer assistant
developer.intro: Ask about the open DAG, operators, provider APIs, failed runs and their logs. Changes come back as a diff you review before applying.

admin.label: Admin
admin.title: Admin assistant
admin.intro: Ask how this AutoAir is set up and used: configuration, feature flags, roles and permissions, audit trail, AI usage, replicas and deploy targets. Read-only.

developer.explain: Explain what this DAG does and what could break in production.
developer.retries: Add sensible retries and timeouts to every task.
developer.failure: Why did the last run of this DAG fail?
developer.sensor: Which deferrable sensor should I use to wait for a file in S3?

admin.deploy: Why can't a Viewer deploy, and what would I change to allow it?
admin.usage: How much did AI cost this month, per user?

chat.title: Ask AI
chat.placeholder: Ask anything… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.hint: Answers may be wrong: check sources and review every change before applying it.
chat.cancelled: Stopped before an answer was given.
chat.interrupted: The connection dropped before the answer was complete.

stage.collect: Reading the run and its logs…

proposal.newDag: A new DAG (nothing deployed to compare with).
proposal.appliedHelp: Review it on the canvas, then deploy through the usual deploy dialog.
proposal.needsWrite: Applying a change needs the spec:write permission
proposal.failed: The proposal could not be updated
proposal.snippetHelp: A suggestion only: nothing was changed. Apply it to your configuration yourself.

troubleshoot.hint: Find the root cause with AI and get a fix to review
troubleshoot.unavailable: AI analysis is not available (AI off, no model, or no airflow:read)
troubleshoot.title: Analyze with AI
troubleshoot.scopeHelp: Logs, task states, the DAG spec and generated code are always included. Narrow or widen the rest; options your administrator disabled are greyed out.

scopes.connections: Connection metadata (type, host, extra keys; never secrets)

troubleshoot.mcpTools: Click a tool to leave it out.
troubleshoot.question: Question (optional)
troubleshoot.questionPlaceholder: e.g. Why does load_orders time out only on Mondays?
troubleshoot.applied: The fix is in the editor
troubleshoot.appliedHelp: Deploy it through the normal deploy dialog; the deployment is recorded with this analysis.
troubleshoot.approvedNoSpec: Approved. The change could not be applied automatically: follow the instructions.
troubleshoot.decisionFailed: The decision could not be recorded
troubleshoot.noSummary: The analysis ended without a summary.
troubleshoot.actionsHelp: Instructions only: AutoAir does not run them for you.
troubleshoot.actionsModeHelp: What may happen with the Airflow actions the analysis proposes. You can only choose a mode as strict as the server allows or stricter.

modeHelp.read_only: Instructions only: AutoAir does not run them for you.
modeHelp.hitl: Each action runs only when you click Execute. It uses your own Airflow permissions.
modeHelp.apply: Allowed actions ran automatically after the analysis, with your own Airflow permissions.

blocked.not_allowed: This action type is not allowed on this server.
blocked.other_dag: Targets another DAG: only the analysed DAG is allowed.
blocked.other_run: Targets another run: only the analysed run is allowed.
blocked.upstream_not_allowed: Clearing upstream tasks is not allowed.
blocked.downstream_not_allowed: Clearing downstream tasks is not allowed.
blocked.limit: Over the limit of actions per analysis.

troubleshoot.executeFailed: The action could not be run

result.ti_not_found: Task instance not found in the run.
result.not_started: Not started yet: nothing to clear.
result.over_limit: Would clear {{count}} task instances, more than the limit of {{limit}} (ai.troubleshoot.max_cleared_task_instances).
result.run_active: The run is already {{state}}: not cleared again.
result.no_run: The action has no DAG or run.

busy.action_running: This action is already running: someone else approved it a moment ago.

upgrade.title: Airflow upgrade assistant
upgrade.description: Finds Airflow 2 idioms (removed template variables, moved imports, deprecated operators) with ruff's AIR3 rules, AutoAir's rules and optionally AI, and proposes the upgrade as a diff.
upgrade.apply: Apply the upgrade to the editor
upgrade.applied: Upgrade of {{dagId}} applied to the editor: review and deploy it.

deployMessage.hint: Write the description from the changes since the deployed version
deployMessage.subject: Subject: {{title}}

approval.help: The assistant paused before running these tools. Nothing runs until you decide.
approval.truncated: Arguments shortened for display; secrets are masked.
approval.expiredHelp: This approval expired and the tools did not run. Ask again to continue.
approval.cancelledHelp: The conversation moved on; these tool calls did not run.
approval.newMessageCancels: Sending a new message cancels the pending tool approval.
